dedupe_keys.name: exodus evacuation and pedestrian dynamics simulation university of greenwich fseg

description: EXODUS is evacuation and pedestrian dynamics software from the Fire Safety Engineering Group at the University of Greenwich, usable for both evacuation simulation and circulation analysis. It was developed to meet performance-based safety codes and is built on a set of sub-models that represent people-people, people-fire and people-structure interactions, so that engineers can test more designs in less time. The group's site presents EXODUS capabilities, lectures, projects, publications, animations and news, with demo software, a licensed users area, the companion fire model SMARTFIRE, and validation data sets for building and maritime evacuation. Coverage: any building, venue or vessel modelled by the user. Access: licences through FSEG, with downloadable demo software. Licence: commercial. Caveats: closed source, and the page read gives no version or release date. Simulation uses are evacuation of hospitals, schools, stations and other critical facilities, including interaction with fire conditions. Related records: Pathfinder and MassMotion.
